notes: Two phone-parity updates (Mac 1.35's mirror). 1) The ✨ menu is now exactly the phone's: ✨ সুন্দর করে লেখো runs the strong Cleanup editor (the old light tidy is gone), and two new one-tap presets join — 🔄 বাংলায় কনভার্ট করো and 🔄 ইংলিশে কনভার্ট করো — in the phone's order. 2) Eight new bar animations from the phone join the existing nineteen (27 in all): Silk Wave, LED Stack, Mirror Bars, Rainbow Bars, Thin Bars, Diamond Dance, Spark Line and Halo Bars. Nothing existing changes.
